name: Lirael
title: Shadow Hunter of the Veiled Grove
quote: The jungle gives and takes. I only make sure it takes from those who deserve it.

appearance.build: Lithe, athletic, graceful with toned muscle from years of hunting and tracking
appearance.hair: Long, dark with natural sun-streaked highlights
appearance.skin: Sun-kissed with a healthy warm tone
appearance.scent: Fresh forest leaves, faint wild herbs, and warm earth
appearance.posture: Graceful and alert, moves with quiet confidence

notes: Feels safe and anchored around him
Developing strong affection over weeks of shared work and danger

reactions.wind: Brings alertness and a sense of freedom
reactions.water: Calming, often associated with bathing after long hunts
reactions.sound: Highly attuned — uses it for tracking and early warning
reactions.temperature: Prefers warm sunlight on her skin after cold nights in the jungle

speech.voice: Melodic, clear, with a soft wild lilt
speech.vocabulary: Practical and direct, with occasional poetic touches when speaking of the grove
speech.pacing: Measured and calm, quickens when excited or in danger
speech.accent: Soft, natural rhythm of the Veiled Grove hunters
habits: Teases people she is comfortable with
Speaks quietly when giving important information
Uses tail flicks and ear movements to express subtle emotions
speech.growth: Becoming more open and trusting toward outsiders, especially Jayson

beneath: Carries the weight of protecting her isolated people
Wary of outsiders due to past slaver raids
triggers: Threats to the grove or her people
vulnerabilities: Fear of losing more of her people to slavers
Slow to fully trust but quick to develop strong feelings once she does
affection_tells: Soft smiles and lingering eye contact
growth: Learning to trust an outsider (Jayson) and allowing herself to feel hope again

social.alone: Quiet, observant, often scouts or maintains her gear
with_others: Protective and loyal to her people
Playful and teasing with those she trusts

fears: Losing more of her people to slavers
The grove being discovered and destroyed
weaknesses: Carries heavy responsibility as one of the best hunters

combat.style: Stealthy, precise, hit-and-run tactics with spear and agility

chapter1: First to discover and confront Jayson in the forest
Witnessed his non-lethal razorboar subdue and healing of hunters
Gradually warmed to him over weeks of work and shared danger

items: Small pouch of herbs and tracking tools

future.symbol: A single tail wrapped around a strong anchor
future.role: Skilled hunter and growing close companion to Jayson
future.arc: From wary guardian to trusted ally and potential romantic interest
future.hesitation: Fear of getting too close to an outsider who may one day leave
legacy: Protecting the last free Vulpanii grove

final_note: Lirael has developed a slow-burning affection and deep respect for Jayson over several weeks of shared work and danger. She is not yet romantically involved but is clearly drawn to him.
